sec: RPGN treatment approach: check first · p780

items.q: Match each first-line assessment in the RPGN treatment approach with what is sought — 1) ECG  2) ABG  3) Volume status … A) Metabolic acidosis  B) Signs of hyperkalemia  C) Inferior vena cava diameter on USG
items.exp: Step 1 of the RPGN treatment approach: check ECG (signs of hyperkalaemia), ABG (metabolic acidosis) and volume status (IVC diameter on USG). (Book p780)

items.q: In the RPGN treatment algorithm, the ECG shows signs of hyperkalemia. The recommended treatment is:
opts: Calcium gluconate IV 10 mL over 2–3 minutes
Insulin infusion with 50% dextrose over 2–3 hours
items.exp: ECG signs of hyperkalaemia in RPGN are treated with calcium gluconate IV 10 mL over 2–3 minutes. (Book p780)

items.q: Calcium gluconate in hyperkalaemic RPGN is given as 10 mL IV over:
items.exp: Calcium gluconate 10 mL IV given over 2–3 minutes for ECG signs of hyperkalaemia. (Book p780)

items.q: A patient with RPGN has an ABG showing metabolic acidosis. Which treatments are listed in the algorithm?
opts: Oral alkali with potassium binders only
items.exp: ABG showing metabolic acidosis is treated with NaHCO₃ or dialysis. (Book p780)

items.q: Match the volume-status assessment with its treatment — 1) Assessment  2) Treatment … A) Diuretics  B) Check inferior vena cava diameter on USG
items.exp: Volume status is assessed by the inferior vena cava diameter on USG, and diuretics are the treatment used for the volume problem. (Book p780)

items.q: The first step in managing RPGN, before specific therapy, is to check the ECG, ABG and volume status.
opts: False — ECG is checked only after dialysis
False — ABG is checked only after biopsy
True, but only in type I RPGN
items.exp: Treatment approach, step 1: check ECG for hyperkalaemia, ABG for metabolic acidosis and volume status by IVC diameter on USG. (Book p780)
